representation_cases.real_plus_complex: phase lattice Z; compact rank one gauges its only phase, while rank zero is the unchanged global-phase theory; hence no compact-gauged relational phase survives
representation_cases.real_plus_complex_scale_result: the two radial kinetic matrix obeys the same diagonal Ward/positivity lemma, so the extra real modulus does not create an independent healthy dressed-trace scale column

selected_preflight_case.reason: It is the unique minimal faithful compact rank that leaves one continuous phase after quotient.

claim_boundary: This exact preflight classifies two formal-polar complex compensators, at most two compact U(1) generators with integer charge lattice up to GL(Z), two real scale columns, the complete declared minimal parity-even two-derivative scalar bilinears and regular quartic potential, and the certified cylinder/Berger homogeneous fixtures. Primitive compact rank one genuinely leaves a relative clock and evades the one-field Gauss obstruction. The good locus is nevertheless empty because positive active scalar kinetic, an independent dressed-trace scale direction and an ungauged relative clock cannot coexist in the declared representation. This does not exclude more fields, non-Riemannian or constrained target kinetics, higher derivatives, other potentials, boundaries, backgrounds or gauge representations. No selected action, full BV carrier, causal parent, nonlinear q2, Hadamard, anomaly/QME, particle, scattering, positivity or unitarity theorem follows.

constant_scale_Ward_system.constant_parameter_exhaustiveness: A constant eta already imposes these weights; derivatives and integration by parts cannot cancel them.

complete_healthy_strata.b1=b2=a_and_s2_nonzero: gauge rank is three only because eta shifts the surviving relative phase theta2; the relational clock is gauge

b1=b2=a_and_s2_zero.disposition: relative clock survives, but no new dressed-trace gauge direction exists

complete_healthy_strata.some_b_i_not_a: candidate scale can be independent on radial/metric rows, but the corresponding scalar kinetic row is null; positive two-field inertia fails

first_incompatible_trichotomy: independent by scale weights => null/indefinite scalar kinetic
independent by relative-phase shift => physical clock gauged
healthy scalar kinetic plus physical clock => candidate reducible

positive_kinetic_lemma.Ward_consequence: positive diagonal entries and the two diagonal Ward rows force b1=a and b2=a
positive_kinetic_lemma.semidefinite_boundary: if K_ii=0 in a positive-semidefinite matrix, det K>=0 forces K_12=0; every weight-mismatched field is a null row/column rather than a healthy active mode

positive_neutral_clock_regression.interpretation: The primitive rank-one lattice genuinely permits the old positive Berger clock in the neutral relative phase. The terminal failure is the scale/trace trichotomy, not stationarity or compact Gauss.

stationarity_and_charges.stationarity_disposition: A nonzero relative-clock stationary sector exists, so neither background stationarity nor compact Gauss is the no-go. It does not intersect a healthy independent dressed-trace scale gauge.

unit_cylinder_metric_rows.radial_rows: K^R f+grad_f V4=0; two exact polynomial rows

terminal_verdict.compact_charge_lattice_result: primitive rank one leaves one legitimate relative phase and passes the compact-Gauss clock separator
terminal_verdict.first_obstruction: positive two-field scalar kinetic forces b1=b2=a; the candidate scale is then reducible if the relative clock survives, while making it independent by s2!=0 gauges that clock
terminal_verdict.next_gate: No automatic minimal successor. A new item must change the kinetic representation (for example non-Riemannian target constraints), add a distinct scale modulus/generator pair, or relax the dressed-trace/relative-clock requirements explicitly.
